Here are the answers to the math word problems:

[id 220]
Carmen spent 10 * 3 + 5 * 8 = 30 + 40 = 70 minutes playing these games.

[id 221]
Celine used 90 liters of water. The remaining water is 120 - 90 = 30 liters. She collected 2 * 30 = 60 liters of rainwater. The total water in the tank now is 30 + 60 = 90 liters.

[id 222]
Andy plants 90 + 40 = 130 flowers.

[id 223]
The company spent $15000 + (1/3) * $15000 = $15000 + $5000 = $20000 on advertising for the two years.

[id 224]
Carlos and Benji will pay $30 * 3 + $18 * 5 = $90 + $90 = $180 for their rentals.

[id 225]
Andrew will travel for 6 + (1/2) * 6 = 6 + 3 = 9 days.

[id 226]
James has 30 - 8 = 22 water type cards left. He has 14 grass type cards. The total number of cards is 30 + 20 + 40 = 90. The percentage chance of a water type card is (22 / 90) * 100 = 24.44... which rounds to 24.

[id 227]
Chad owes $6.50 + $2.00 + $1.00 + $1.00 + $0.25 + $0.25 - $5.00 = $2.75.

[id 228]
Kalinda can add 4 pieces per minute, so she adds 4 * 360 = 1440 pieces in an hour. Her mom adds half as many pieces per minute, so she adds 2 * 360 = 720 pieces in an hour. Together, they add 1440 + 720 = 2160 pieces in an hour. The total number of pieces is 360. The time it takes them to complete the puzzle is 360 / 2160 = 1/6 hours. Converting this to hours, we get 1/6 = 0.166... hours. Converting this to minutes, we get 0.166... * 60 = 10 minutes.

{id 229]
30% of 120 watermelons is 120 * 0.3 = 36 watermelons. 36 watermelons were harvested. The remaining watermelons are 120 - 36 = 84. 3/4 of the remaining melons are 84 * (3/4) = 63 watermelons. 63 watermelons were harvested. The remaining watermelons are 84 - 63 = 21.
